tweet.text: Congress needs to convene a special session on AI and what the future of the U.S. looks like. There are very real impacts to society as we know it. Partisan politics aside, there are massive implications of a race towards super intelligence. This is not a doomer post, as some of the advancements will greatly impact access to healthcare, targeted treatments, increase in safer food production etc… but not enough of Congress is focusing on this. Our first priority is protecting ALL Americans. To include data, privacy, and physical safety. We MUST be ready. This is happening whether or not we want it to.
